methodology: Empirical quantile calibration on French MTPL benchmark portfolio using trained Poisson-Gamma GLMs

tiers.name: Low
tiers.description: Favorable risk profile; lower pure risk than 70% of portfolio.

tiers.name: Moderate
tiers.description: Standard market risk profile; 30th to 70th empirical quantile.

tiers.name: High
tiers.description: Elevated risk profile; 70th to 90th empirical quantile.

tiers.name: Very High
tiers.description: Substantially heightened risk; top 10% highest expected pure premium.
